ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: fought side by side
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They held the line together once. People who have done that don't forget it.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: tended while down
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of them lay hurt on the ground and the other patched them up. That sort of thing is owed for a long time.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: buried someone together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They stood at the same grave. Grief shared is a bond of its own.
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.text: stood together at the grave of {LABEL}

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a gathering together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A good night, the kind people bring up for years.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: came through a disaster
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They came through it together, and it still comes up when the sky turns strange.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: travelled together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: Weeks on the road together, sharing a fire and a tent. They know each other's snoring.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: built something together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They raised it together, and walk past it a little prouder.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a long night together
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They kept each other going through the small hours, while everyone else slept.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: taught and learned
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One taught, the other learned, and both remember the lessons.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: made up after a quarrel
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: They fell out and found their way back. Some friendships are stronger for it.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: a secret confided
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One trusted the other with something nobody else knows, and the other has kept it.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the bad stew
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A meal that disagreed with them. It's funny now. It was not funny then.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the explosion
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: An animal that went off like a powder keg with the two of them far too close. Nobody was hurt, eyebrows aside.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the tame that went wrong
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A tame that went badly wrong, with one of them running and the other watching. Everyone came out of it fine, more or less.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the little fire
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: A small fire they beat out together, with more shouting than was strictly needed.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the mud
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One went down in the mud, the other went down trying to help. Nobody stayed clean or dignified.

ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.label: the long night
ColonyCouncil.SharedMemoryDef.description: One of them had a night of it, and the other was there. It's been forgiven, and is never going to be forgotten.
